full_judgment: 7. At the time of hearing of this Rule, a supplementary-affidavit on behalf of the accused-petitioners with some Annexures, namely, annexure 'D' a copy of an ejahar by one Shahidul against the accused Asimuddin, Amjad and others, Annexure 'E' a copy of charge-sheet No. 32 dated 24.9.87 under sections 143/448/323/436/307 and 114 of the Penal Code, Annexure 'E' a copy of the notice by police under section 145 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, Annexure 'G' a copy of the Charge-sheet No.8 dated 2.3.88 in the instant case, Annexure 'H', copies of the statements of this case and Annexure 'I' a copy of the charge-sheet No.9 dated 2.3.88 in the case of the complainant Haji Rajab Ali, has been filed before us serving a copy of the same on the other side for our consideration.
